Figure 5:Readout change and recurrent readout failure on held out variants.
A, Spearman correlation with held out margin erosion and AUROC for recurrent
failure. Correlation measures erosion transfer, while AUROC measures failure
ranking; residual margin correlations are oriented toward increasing risk.
B, clean margin versus full residual margin for Gemma 3 4B, colored by held
out recurrent failure. The dashed line marks zero average selection margin.

Figure S2:Overlap between the feature supports selected under different transformations, averaged over all units and 1,000 prompts. A, pairwise Jaccard overlap between transformations; B, averages within each model. IC denotes irrelevant context, DC distractor context, MW metalinguistic wrapper, FW format wrapper, PN punctuation noise, and TL typed lexical substitution.

Figure S3:Normalized MeanRSS by prompt topic. A, topic level means for each transformation; B, the ratio of the context and wrapper mean to the local edit mean for each topic. Transformation abbreviations as in FigureS2.
